summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Matt Davidson, a Canadian ice hockey player born in Flin Flon, Manitoba. It describes him as a former National Hockey League right wing who was drafted by the Buffalo Sabres in the 1995 NHL Entry Draft. It also notes that he currently plays for the Frederikshavn Whitehawks in Denmark's Oddset Ligaen.
one_line: Matt Davidson is a former NHL right wing drafted by the Buffalo Sabres in 1995 who now plays in Denmark.
key_facts: Matthew B. Davidson was born on August 9, 1977, in Flin Flon, Manitoba.
Matt Davidson is a former National Hockey League right wing.
Matt Davidson was drafted in the fourth round, 94th overall, by the Buffalo Sabres.
The Buffalo Sabres selected Matt Davidson in the 1995 NHL Entry Draft.
Matt Davidson currently plays with the Frederikshavn Whitehawks.
The Frederikshavn Whitehawks play in Denmark's Oddset Ligaen.
